metadata.title: Developing the Teacher mentoring self-efficacy scale (TMSES) using the Delphi method and exploratory factor analysis

extraction.outcome_summary: The study developed the Teacher Mentoring Self-Efficacy Scale (TMSES) through a two-phase mixed-methods design. In Phase 1, a UK-based Delphi panel generated and refined 44 teacher-mentoring competency statements using reflexive thematic analysis and consensus criteria. In Phase 2, exploratory factor analysis of 239 fully completed TMSES surveys supported a clean two-factor structure (Pedagogical Practices and Professional Relationships) with strong internal consistency (Cronbach’s alpha for the full scale = 0.94). Validity evidence was reported via correlations with comparator items from the Teachers’ Sense of Efficacy Scale (TSES) and the Engaged Teachers Scale (ETS).
